page.layout: One printed page (p. 89), one column of running text. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. No marginal notes. Printed ornaments: a small star after the first paragraph and a dash after the last. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Est autem quoddam Zeli genus cui clemens æquanimitas Tepor est, quique immanem se haberi, quàm frigidum malit: quan-quam crebro etiam hi homines (quicquid simulant) plus pellis suæ caufâ urfum, quam maleficii occidant, cum fit his prœda fifci charitate illâ potior quæ aut vitas conservat aut fanat errores.

Cùm ergo in Hybernia Protestantibus prævalente efferatorum hoftium numero oppressis & novâ indies strage cumulatis omnia auxilia vel negata effent, vel interclusa, id mecum sedulo agebant, & enixe hortabantur omnes ferè in illis locis Protestantium primarii, ut Armorum aliqua cessatione facta spacium illis refpirandi efficerem, sine quo vix posse credebant absque miraculo quæ su-perfuerant reliquias servare. Deus novit quàm tenero animo, & quàm follicite hoc negotium curaverim, idque per viros Honora-biles & spectatæ integritatis, ut nec Rebel-libus crefceret audacia, nec qui in officio manebant Protestantium fides & patientia fran-geretur.

Cum vero hoc commodissima (qua licebat) ratione, in hâc rerum angustia, & diffi-cultate perfecissem, jam mihi nova de inte-gro fubeunda infamia, quod non passus fim perduelles exiguum illud quod erat reliquum Protestantium devorare.

page.notes: The word "Hybernia" and the Protestant and Honorable words are italic as printed. The first paragraph's italics (Zeli, Tepor, pellis, maleficii, fisci) are read from the scan and may be off. Running head Greek read as ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ. Printed star and dash ornaments are not transcribed as text. Long s printed as plain s. "quan-quam" and "su-perfuerant", "pri-marii" etc. are line-end hyphenations kept as printed.
